summary: Iteration 101: Tested the async Ship's Log Batch Magic Scan (background queue, live status, review and confirm) on both backend and frontend. Backend: I updated test_it99_export_folders.py (the paper-log tests still asserted 422 for a missing title or date). 11/11 pass, including one real Gemini OCR call with no title or date (200, non-empty text). Frontend: Playwright with paper-log mocked at a 2-2.5 s delay, run at 1920 and 390. Every requested flow works. Three minor issues found, none blocking.

minor.issue: Aborting on the client (removing a page mid-scan, or closing the dialog) doesn't stop the server. The request has already been received, so quota.consume plus the LLM call still run and a Magic use is spent without a result. The close confirm only counts pages that are 'done', so closing during an in-flight scan silently spends one use.

ui_bugs.issue: When pages fail (503 or 429), the banner still says 'All 3 pages processed' while 2 pages show Didn't work. It should say something like '1 read · 2 didn't work'.

issues: The disabled paper-scan-review-btn ('Processing...' / 'Review 0 log rows') looks exactly like an enabled btn-solid. App.css has no .btn-solid:disabled rule (no opacity or cursor change), so it looks clickable. Add .btn-solid:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed}.

verified: Selecting 3 images queues them at once. Calls go out one at a time, about 2.5 s apart, carrying only the file (no title or date fields).
Banner sequence: 'Processing 1 of 3 · 2 waiting' → '2 of 3 · 1 waiting' → '3 of 3' → 'All 3 pages processed'. data-status moves queued → scanning → done, with labels Waiting / Processing... / Read.
During processing, the title, date and remove controls for every page and paper-scan-add-btn stay enabled. Titles and dates typed mid-scan are kept.
Removing page 0 while it is scanning aborts it, and the next page starts ('1 of 2 · 1 waiting'). Adding a page plus a .txt mid-scan adds only the image ('1 of 3'). That run made 4 calls in total.
20-page cap: adding 21 more gives 20 pages and hides the Add button. Removing one brings back 'Add more pages (19 of 20)'.
Review button reads 'Processing...' (disabled) and then 'Review 3 log rows'. The review step shows 3 rows with thumbnail, title, date and text. Edited text survives Back and returning to Review.

OK with one row missing a title or date shows paper-scan-error 'Give every log row a title and a date.' Once filled in: the dialog closes, a toast appears, and the rows read 'TEST_it101 Day one - Feb 10, 2025: 0800 TEST edited text one'. The DB has log_date 2025-02-10 and paper:true. Fold a year 2025 counts 5 items, so the 3 new rows are included.
503 on a page → Didn't work + message + Try again. Retry re-queues it and it ends as done.
429 on call 2 → pages 2 and 3 both show the error 'Daily Magic limit reached', and no third call is made. Review 1 log row is enabled, and retrying a single page works.

Cancel or Esc with read pages → window.confirm 'Discard 3 scanned pages? ...'. Dismissing keeps the dialog open; accepting closes it. Esc with no read pages closes straight away with no confirm, and the queue stops (no further calls).
390px: documentElement.scrollWidth is 390 on both the pages and review steps; the layout is clean.
Backend: no title or date → 200 (real OCR); 2024/03/01 → 422; 2024-13-45 → 422 'real date'; title over 120 characters → 422; no auth → 401; unknown boat → 404; text/plain → 400; fake png → 400.
action_items: Optional: show failed pages in the progress banner instead of 'All N pages processed' when some pages errored.
Optional: add .btn-solid:disabled styling so the disabled Review button looks disabled.
Optional: when closing or removing while a scan is in flight, warn that its Magic use may already be spent (or count the in-flight page in the confirm).
critical_code_review_comments: Client-side abort can't refund quota: the backend consumes a use before calling the LLM and never checks request.is_disconnected().

Review only lists pages that are done and have non-empty text. Errored pages are silently left out of 'OK, add N rows' with no reminder that they weren't added. This is acceptable, but worth a note in the review description.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows (3 minor UX notes)

seed_data_creation: Seeded TEST_it98_log with manual_it98_shipslog_seed.py (and briefly manual_it99_folders_seed.py for the email test), then re-seeded it98. Cleaned with 'manual_it98_shipslog_seed.py clean' at the end (user, session and boat deleted). One real OCR call used TEST_it98_log's quota.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported. The email folder test needs manual_it99_folders_seed.py applied after the it98 seed. test_missing_title_and_date_200 makes one real Gemini call. For the UI, mock '**/api/boats/*/paper-log' with asyncio.sleep in the handler. Open the Ship's Log via list-selector → list-option-shipsLog (force click). Use page.on('dialog') to handle window.confirm.
